hypothesis: The literal 15-minute Swing Auto plus Heikin-Ashi rule—9/21 EMA, BUY state plus green HA for long, SELL state plus red HA for short, and hold only while both remain aligned—or one bounded development-selected order-block variant transfers to SP500 and SPCX with positive bidirectional after-cost validation performance.
decision: Reject the exact literal 9/21 control and the bounded 50/200 plus order-block variant for execution on SP500 and SPCX. Both mechanisms were negative on the untouched validation segment under nominal and stress friction, and every literal-control asset/direction slice lost. Preserve the final chronological 20% holdout unopened. Do not grant live authority, retune on validation, or use leverage, allocation, regime overlays, or the sealed holdout to rescue this negative entry/exit mechanism. A materially changed mechanism or another market is a new pre-registered hypothesis, not a continuation of these 85 trials.
falsifier: This exact-transfer rejection would be updated by a separately authorized one-time confirmation in which the frozen literal or selected configuration is gross-positive and after-cost positive on the sealed holdout or a fresh non-overlapping venue-matched forward window, with aggregate profit factor above one, both long and short represented, no single asset or event supplying the result, and results surviving the declared stress friction. Changed timestamps, source hashes, trial count, fill assumptions, or any holdout access during selection invalidate the present evidence rather than falsifying it.
limitations: The experiment uses causal L2 midpoint OHLC as a price-path proxy; it does not establish public-trade OHLC, private queue position, passive fill probability, cancellation priority, or adverse selection.
Nominal and stress IOC-style visible costs are sensitivities built from current fee inputs and historical visible books; they are not historical private fills.
The common validation window spans approximately sixteen days and two related equity-index HIP-3 markets; the broader Swing/HA concept remains less certain than this exact rejection.
SP500 and SPCX were simulated as independent $500 reference accounts for selection and validation rather than one shared-capital portfolio.

The selected variant was chosen only on development, but 85 searched trials still create selection risk; validation failure is therefore stronger evidence against promotion than development performance is for it.
The final chronological holdout was not accessed and remains available only for a separately authorized one-time confirmation decision.
No live profile, execution scope, sizing rule, order, position, backend process, or portfolio configuration changed in this research revision.
